remarks: Step into this beautifully updated 3-bedroom, 2-bath fully renovated Colonial in Norwalk's desirable Cranbury neighborhood. This move-in-ready home features hardwood floors throughout, a renovated kitchen, and updated bathrooms that blend classic charm with modern finishes. The layout offers bright, comfortable living spaces and well-proportioned bedrooms ideal for everyday living. Set in a quiet residential area yet close to shopping, dining, and major commuter routes, this home delivers comfort and convenience in one great package. Enjoy the outdoor entertaining area with a side entrance leading to a deck and patio, plus a spacious, level backyard ready to make your own. Whether you are a first-time homebuyer, looking to downsize, or searching for your next step in one of Norwalk's most desirable neighborhoods, this home checks all the boxes.----- HIGHEST AND BEST BY TUESDAY 12/23 @ 12PM.
